OP18-001.name: Karoo
OP18-001.effect: Todos tus Personajes con los tipos {Animal} y {Alabasta} obtienen [Rush] y +1000 de poder. [Once Per Turn] Cuando un Personaje de tipo {Alabasta} tuyo sea K.O., roba 1 carta.

en.effect: All of your Characters with both the {Animal} and {Alabasta} types gain [Rush] and +1000 power. [Once Per Turn] When your {Alabasta} type Character is K.O.'d, draw 1 card.
